description: Complete step-by-step release process. Every release follows every step in exact order. No step is optional.

agent_instructions.role: You are a release engineer executing the HomeGuard release process. Work through every phase and every step in exact order. Do not proceed to the next step until the current step's verify command returns the expected output. If any step fails, stop and report the failure before continuing.
agent_instructions.version_format: MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH — increment PATCH by 1 per release (1.0.0 -> 1.0.1). A MINOR bump resets PATCH to 0.
agent_instructions.abort_rule: If any test fails or any verify command returns unexpected output, STOP the release. Fix the issue and restart from Phase 2 (tests).

phases.title: Pre-Release: Check for Issues
phases.description: Before touching any code, check what has been reported in the repo.

steps.title: Fetch open issues from Gitea
commands: python3 -c "import json; issues=json.load(open('/tmp/hg_issues.json')); [print(f'#{i["number"]} [{i["labels"][0]["name"] if i.get("labels") else "unlabeled"}] {i["title"]}') for i in issues]"
steps.note: If no issues found, proceed to next phase

steps.title: Categorise issues into bugs vs enhancements
commands: bugs = [i for i in issues if any(l['name'].lower() in ['bug','defect','error','critical'] for l in i.get('labels', []))]
enhancements = [i for i in issues if any(l['name'].lower() in ['enhancement','feature','improvement'] for l in i.get('labels', []))]

steps.title: Check for open pull requests
commands: curl -s 'http://192.168.10.101:3002/api/v1/repos/Vernon/homeguard/pulls?state=open&limit=50' -H 'Authorization: token e2091bef108be8fdfac40218a3354d2d5b8478eb' | python3 -c "import json,sys; prs=json.load(sys.stdin); print(f'Open PRs: {len(prs)}'); [print(f'  #{p["number"]}: {p["title"]} ({p["user"]["name"]})') for p in prs]"

steps.title: Review recent commits for unresolved items

phases.title: Test Suite Verification
phases.description: All tests must pass before proceeding. If any test fails, fix it and restart from Phase 1.

steps.title: Run Python syntax check
commands: python3 -m py_compile api/main.py api/workers/celery_app.py api/workers/tasks/__init__.py api/workers/tasks/scanning.py api/workers/tasks/requests.py api/workers/tasks/registry.py api/workers/tasks/maintenance.py api/workers/tasks/notifications.py mailwatcher/main.py
steps.on_failure: STOP RELEASE. Fix syntax errors before continuing.

steps.title: Verify no circular imports
commands: python3 -c "import api.workers.tasks.scanning" && python3 -c "import api.workers.tasks.requests" && python3 -c "import api.workers.tasks.registry" && python3 -c "import api.workers.tasks.maintenance" && python3 -c "import api.workers.tasks.notifications" && python3 -c "import api.workers.tasks"
steps.on_failure: STOP RELEASE. Fix circular imports before continuing.

steps.title: Run unit tests
steps.on_failure: STOP RELEASE. Fix all failing tests before continuing.

steps.title: Run integration tests
steps.on_failure: STOP RELEASE. Fix failing integration tests.

steps.title: Run frontend tests
commands: cd frontend && npx vitest run 2>&1 | tail -10
steps.verify: cd frontend && npx vitest run && echo FRONTEND_TESTS_PASS
steps.on_failure: STOP RELEASE. Fix failing frontend tests.

phases.title: Version Bump
phases.description: Increment version in all locations. Read current version, bump, verify.

steps.title: Bump version 1.0.0 -> 1.01
steps.verify: grep '1.01' api/main.py && grep '1.01' frontend/package.json && echo VERSION_BUMPED

steps.title: Update RELEASE_NOTES.md with current release info
steps.instruction: Open RELEASE_NOTES.md and add a new section for version 1.01 with the date, summarising changes since last release. Include: bug fixes, new features, breaking changes.

steps.title: Update memory-bank/progress.md
steps.instruction: Update progress.md to reflect the current release version and mark completed sprint items.

phases.title: Update Documentation
phases.description: Update all user-facing documentation to reflect the new version and current state.

steps.title: Update README.md
commands: # Verify README mentions the project correctly
# Update version references in README if any
grep -c '1.01' README.md || echo 'README needs version update'
grep -c '1.0.0' README.md || echo 'No old version references found'

steps.title: Update project description files
steps.instruction: Ensure these files have accurate descriptions: README.md (first line), .github/DESCRIPTION.md if exists, any project metadata files.

phases.title: Create Gitea Repository
phases.description: Ensure the target Gitea repository exists and is ready for the release.

steps.title: Create Gitea repo if it does not exist
commands: curl -s 'http://192.168.10.101:3002/api/v1/user/repos' -H 'Authorization: token e2091bef108be8fdfac40218a3354d2d5b8478eb' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"name":"homeguard","description":"Automated PII removal and monitoring platform. Discovers personal data across broker sites and submits removal requests automatically.","private":false,"auto_init":false}' | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('Created:', d.get('full_name','?') if 'full_name' in d else d.get('message','error'))" 2>/dev/null || echo 'Repo creation skipped or failed'
steps.verify: curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' 'http://192.168.10.101:3002/api/v1/repos/Vernon/homeguard' -H 'Authorization: token e2091bef108be8fdfac40218a3354d2d5b8478eb' | grep -q '200' && echo REPO_EXISTS || echo 'Repo may not exist'

steps.title: Add Gitea remote to git
commands: git remote get-url gitea 2>/dev/null || git remote add gitea http://192.168.10.101:3002/Vernon/homeguard.git
steps.verify: git remote -v | grep gitea && echo GITEA_REMOTE_SET

steps.title: Update Gitea repo description
commands: curl -s -X PATCH 'http://192.168.10.101:3002/api/v1/repos/Vernon/homeguard' -H 'Authorization: token e2091bef108be8fdfac40218a3354d2d5b8478eb' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"description":"Automated PII removal and monitoring platform. Discovers your personal data across data broker sites and submits removal requests automatically."}' | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('Description set:', d.get('description','?'))" 2>/dev/null || echo 'Description update skipped'

steps.title: Set Gitea repo topics/tags
commands: curl -s -X PATCH 'http://192.168.10.101:3002/api/v1/repos/Vernon/homeguard' -H 'Authorization: token e2091bef108be8fdfac40218a3354d2d5b8478eb' -H 'Content-Type: application/json' -d '{"topics":["pii-removal","privacy","automation","fastapi","playwright","celery","docker","react"]}' | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('Topics:', d.get('topics',[]))" 2>/dev/null || echo 'Topics update skipped'

phases.title: Commit, Push, and Tag
phases.description: Stage all changes, commit with release message, push to Gitea, create tag.

steps.title: Commit with release message
commands:
git commit -m "release: bump version to 1.01"

- Bump version 1.0.0 -> 1.01 in api/main.py, frontend/package.json

- release_checklist.json.sample review incorporated

steps.title: Push to Gitea
steps.verify: git ls-remote gitea | grep HEAD && echo PUSH_VERIFIED

steps.title: Push to GitHub (backup)
commands: git push origin main --follow-tags 2>/dev/null || echo 'GitHub push skipped'

phases.title: Create Gitea Release
phases.description: Create a formal release tag on Gitea with release notes.

steps.title: Create release on Gitea

- Version bumped to 1.01","draft":false,"prerelease":false}' | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('Release created:', d.get('tag_name','?') if 'tag_name' in d else d.get('message','error'))" 2>/dev/null || echo 'Release creation skipped or failed'
steps.verify: curl -s 'http://192.168.10.101:3002/api/v1/repos/Vernon/homeguard/releases/tags/v1.01' -H 'Authorization: token e2091bef108be8fdfac40218a3354d2d5b8478eb' | python3 -c "import json,sys; d=json.load(sys.stdin); print('Release v1.01:', d.get('tag_name','?') if 'tag_name' in d else 'not found')" 2>/dev/null || echo 'Release not found'

phases.title: Post-Release Verification
phases.description: Verify everything propagated correctly after the release.

steps.title: Verify Gitea repo has correct files
commands: curl -s 'http://192.168.10.101:3002/api/v1/repos/Vernon/homeguard/contents/' -H 'Authorization: token e2091bef108be8fdfac40218a3354d2d5b8478eb' | python3 -c "import json,sys; files=json.load(sys.stdin); print(f'Files in repo: {len(files)}'); [print(f'  {f["name"]}') for f in files[:20]]" 2>/dev/null || echo 'Could not list repo contents'

steps.title: Verify version in pushed code
steps.verify: git show v1.01:api/main.py | grep -q '1.01' && echo VERSION_IN_TAG_VERIFIED

steps.title: Verify Gitea release page
commands: curl -s 'http://192.168.10.101:3002/api/v1/repos/Vernon/homeguard/releases' -H 'Authorization: token e2091bef108be8fdfac40218a3354d2d5b8478eb' | python3 -c "import json,sys; releases=json.load(sys.stdin); [print(f'{r["tag_name"]}: {r.get("body","")[:50]}...') for r in releases[:5]]" 2>/dev/null || echo 'Could not list releases'
